notes: A side of the quietStartup A/B: the header must be gone on the *first frame*, which is only possible if `quietStartup` was read before `AppConfig` was built.
The `probe` entries name the post-fix behaviour, so running this same scenario against a pre-fix binary records XFAIL instead of failing the run — that is how one file documents both sides.
The composer and status bar must still be there: silencing the header must not cost the prompt.
caption: LUM-1310 — quietStartup=true: the same binary paints no startup header on frame one, and the composer still owns the bottom. Compare with lum1310-quiet-startup-off.json. Real binary + real PTY + pyte VT emulator; nothing mocked.
